caption: Before you hand any part of your business to automation, ask these five questions. A good provider will answer every one without dodging. Which one would you want answered first?

slides.headline: 5 questions to ask before buying any automation
What exact job does it do?
slides.body: If the answer is vague, walk away. One clear job beats ten loose promises.

slides.headline: What does it say to my customers?
slides.body: You should see the messages before they go out, in your voice.

slides.headline: What happens when it's unsure?
slides.body: A good agent hands the conversation back to you instead of guessing.

slides.headline: Who is in control?
slides.body: You should be able to pause it or change it whenever you like.

slides.headline: What does it cost to leave?
slides.body: No long lock-in. If it's not working, you should be free to stop.
